description: SLS v1.0.14 retired §0.3's Tier-1-only publication clause for M5, and widened the published set to all four scanned timeframes. The gate must be gone rather than permanently open: a `tier_permitted` argument has to be refused, not accepted and ignored, and no universe state may be read to decide a publication. Run from backend/: uv run python -m tests.support.mutation_battery tests/mutations/tier_gate_retired.json

mutations.name: a retired suppression reason is appended again, unconditionally
the published-timeframe gate stops being enforced at all
the config default narrows back to H1,H4
the fail-closed default narrows back, drifting from the config one
D1 dropped from the ingest ladder
mutations.old:
# its lower neighbour too.
    ingest_timeframes: str = "M5,M15,H1,H4,D1"
mutations.new:
# its lower neighbour too.
    ingest_timeframes: str = "M5,M15,H1,H4"

mutations.name: the worker's ladder drifts from ingest's, undercounting §6.6
mutations.old:
# crashing, which is why the two are worth keeping visibly identical.
    ingest_timeframes: str = "M5,M15,H1,H4,D1"
mutations.new:
# crashing, which is why the two are worth keeping visibly identical.
    ingest_timeframes: str = "M5,M15,H1,H4"
